strings.security.breached_d: Matches in Pwned Passwords. Only five SHA-1 prefix characters leave this device.
strings.security.incomplete_d: No service name or no username.
strings.security.malformed_d: Missing a secret, or an algorithm SPM cannot generate codes for.
strings.security.reused_d: Each group below shares one password. Changing all but one clears the finding.
strings.security.scope: Only password entries are scored. Names are shown, hidden entries stay redacted, and secrets never appear.

strings.security.weak_d: Shorter than 12 characters, or using fewer than three character classes.
strings.settings.effect_backup: Keeps the previous vault as a .bak and a history snapshot.
strings.settings.effect_recovery: Rewrites the recovery file so "spm forgot" keeps working.
strings.settings.effect_sessions: Signs out every other browser session.
strings.settings.effect_vault: Re-encrypts the whole vault under the new password.
strings.settings.hardware.desc: Manage the keys that can open this vault without your master password.
strings.settings.hardware.title: Security Keys
strings.settings.hint: At least 12 characters. There is no way to recover a master password you forget — only the recovery file and its private key can reset it.
strings.settings.hosts.desc: Host names you would rather not have on screen. Used only to propose hiding entries in Tidy.
strings.settings.hosts.label: Host names
strings.settings.hosts.note: One per line or separated by commas. SPM ships no list of its own. This one is stored inside your encrypted vault, not in a settings file, because a list of sites you would rather not name is itself worth protecting. It only ever suggests — every entry keeps whichever switch you set on it.
strings.settings.hosts.title: Sites to suggest hiding
strings.settings.lock.desc: How long the Dashboard waits before locking itself.
strings.settings.lock.label: Lock after
strings.settings.lock.note: A longer wait leaves the decrypted vault on screen for longer. The server ends an idle session shortly after this timer, whatever the browser is doing.
